note: tiffcp copies every input directory tag listed in its `tags[]` table -- including TIFFTAG_SMINSAMPLEVALUE (TIFF_DOUBLE, tools/tiffcp.c:577) -- from the untrusted input TIFF straight to the output TIFF's in-memory directory (td->td_sminsamplevalue, a double array), with no range validation. When the output directory is written, TIFFWriteDirectorySec() (libtiff/tif_dirwrite.c:589) calls TIFFWriteDirectoryTagSampleformatArray(tif,&ndir,dir,TIFFTAG_SMINSAMPLEVALUE,td_samplesperpixel,td->td_sminsamplevalue) with that attacker-controlled double array as `value`. For the SAMPLEFORMAT_INT / bitspersample<=16 case, each element is narrowed with a bare `(int16)value[i]` C-style cast and no range check -- a double outside int16's representable range ([-32768,32767]) is undefined behavior (UBSan: "outside the range of representable values of type 'short'").

((int16*)conv)[i] = (int16)value[i] -- bare C-style cast narrows the attacker-controlled double with no range check; a value outside int16's range is undefined behavior
